title: J20 · Use a Thin Trigger and a Focused Handler

ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand what starts a trigger». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An Apex trigger runs in response to specified database events, such as inserting or updating records. Before triggers run before the final stored result is established and can be useful for checking or changing incoming values. After triggers serve different needs, including work that relies on saved identifiers. Choose the event from the requirement rather than using after update for every problem. Oleg agrees two small rules for this lesson. A Confirmed appointment must identify its vehicle, customer, and scheduled time. An existing Completed appointment must not change status. This is not a complete scheduling state machine: it does not check calendar overlap or guarantee that every possible business transition is covered. Those limits are explicit.

cues.label: 03 · Read old and new values for the whole collection

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read old and new values for the whole collection». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Trigger.new contains the incoming records for supported events. Trigger.oldMap provides previous records keyed by ID for update scenarios. Comparing old and new values lets the handler distinguish an actual transition from an unrelated edit. Repeating the same Completed status is not a change and should not be rejected by the terminal-status rule. The handler loops over every incoming record, not only the first. addError marks an invalid record with an explanation. Whether a caller permits partial success affects the overall save result; the normal all-or-none DML statement can fail the group. Do not claim that addError always produces exactly the same batch outcome regardless of the calling operation.

Create a valid Confirmed appointment with all three references or values. Then attempt to confirm an incomplete request and expect the explanatory failure. For the transition rule, create an appropriate synthetic Completed appointment and attempt to move it back to Requested. Also edit an unrelated allowed field while leaving Completed unchanged; this specific rule should not reject that operation. Include multiple records in a single DML call so that the loop matters. A handler that only checks pending[0] could pass a single-record example while ignoring the rest. In J22, turn these cases into automated tests with assertions. For now, record the predicted and observed behaviour carefully.
For the practical work, keep the trigger limited to context dispatch.
